latestVersion.changelog:
claw-vision 1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Analyze images using Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview (NUWA Flux) via vision-tool.py.
- Supports local PNG, JPG, JPEG, GIF, and WEBP files.
- Outputs structured results: summary, key fields, UI elements, and confidence level.
- Triggered when users send image files or relevant keywords/commands.
